## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New canary kind, transform or decoy template
- [ ] Integration or output format
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `pytest` passes and new behaviour has tests
- [ ] New transforms have a detection test and a no-false-positive test
- [ ] No real registries, planted canaries or hit logs included
